snippet.title: Wheel-to-wheel Racing (Work In Progress)
snippet.description:
A short preview of the current development progress on the wheel to wheel racing, showing the change in technical direction from 'racing line' to 'center line' based positioning.

Work continues on now ensuring cars utilise the racing line more effectively under the new system.
